solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-digit-one/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

233. Number of Digit One

Given an integer n, count the total number of digit 1 appearing in all non-negative integers less than or equal to n.

Example 1:

Input: n = 13
Output: 6

Example 2:

Input: n = 0
Output: 0

Constraints:

    0 <= n <= 10^9
"""


class Solution:
    def countDigitOne(self, n: int) -> int:
        count = 0
        i = 1
        while i <= n:
            divider = i * 10
            count += (n // divider) * i + min(max(n % divider - i + 1, 0), i)
            i *= 10
        return count


sol = Solution()

print(sol.countDigitOne(13))  # 6

assert sol.countDigitOne(13) == 6
assert sol.countDigitOne(0) == 0

assert sol.countDigitOne(1) == 1
assert sol.countDigitOne(10) == 2
assert sol.countDigitOne(11) == 4
assert sol.countDigitOne(99) == 20
assert sol.countDigitOne(100) == 21
assert sol.countDigitOne(101) == 23
assert sol.countDigitOne(110) == 33
assert sol.countDigitOne(111) == 36
assert sol.countDigitOne(999) == 300
assert sol.countDigitOne(1000) == 301
assert sol.countDigitOne(10**9) == 900000001
assert sol.countDigitOne(123456789) == 130589849
